rules.name: Refund request handling
rules.instructions: Acknowledge frustration, verify purchase details, offer refund or escalate to human if over $100.

rules.name: Greeting and farewell
rules.whenCondition: User says thank you or goodbye
rules.instructions: Reply warmly, ask if anything else is needed, share a link to our Help Centre.

rules.name: Subscription cancellation
rules.instructions: Acknowledge the request, offer a pause option first, then escalate to human — never cancel automatically.
